//: Copy to ~/.simcheck/config.json and delete what you do not need.
//_: Every key is optional; omitted keys use the built-in default shown here.
//_platforms: Which platforms this daemon serves. One whose toolchain is missing is reported as unavailable rather than blocking startup.
//_android: Defaults for pooled emulators. androidRuntime: '' means the newest installed system image.
//_androidSdk: Empty means: ANDROID_HOME, then ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, then the usual install locations.
//_androidDriver: Built multi-touch driver APKs. Empty means the driver/ directory beside this install.
//_pool: A heterogeneous pool, across platforms and runtimes. Overrides poolSize when set.
//_exposure: The daemon REFUSES to bind beyond 127.0.0.1 while edgeAuth is 'none'.
//_cloudflare: edgeAuth: 'cloudflare-access' -- run `simcheck tunnel <host>` for the setup steps.
//_ztna: edgeAuth: 'trusted-proxy' -- for a Netskope NPA publisher or an internal reverse proxy.
//_binding: Which bearer tokens an edge identity may use, so neither credential works alone.
//_tls: Corporate root CA for networks that inspect TLS. Re-run ./install.sh after setting this -- Node reads NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS once at startup.
//_remote: Remote MCP, for Claude connectors including the phone app. Claude's cloud dials this, so it must be publicly reachable -- Tailscale will not work.
//_remoteToken: Token the remote MCP server uses against the daemon. Scope it down: `simcheck token create phone --preset remote`.
